questions.text: What is computation? Prove $1+4+7+\cdots+(3n-2)=\frac{n(3n-1)}{2}$ for $n>0$ using principle of mathematical induction.
What is Deterministic Finite Automata (DFA)? Give the DFA accepting the languages over the alphabet $\{0,1\}$ that have the set of all strings whose $10^{th}$ symbol from the right end is 1.
If $L$ is accepted by a Nondeterministic Finite Automata (NFA) with $\varepsilon$-transition then show that $L$ is accepted by an NFA without $\varepsilon$-transition.
How will you test the membership of a string in NFA? Explain with an example.
Design a NFA that accepts the language $L=\{w\in\{a,b\}: w \text{ contains the substring } aa\}$. Also show the states NFA will be in during the processing of valid input.

Convert the following NFA to its equivalent DFA.

| | 0 | 1 |
|---|---|---|
| p | {p, q} | {p} |
| q | {r} | {r} |
| r | {s} | φ |
| *s | {s} | {s} |

Write regular expression/definition for the following languages:

- (i) The set of all strings of 0's and 1's such that no prefix has two more 0's than 1's, not two more 1's than 0's.
- (ii) The set of all strings of 0's and 1's whose no. of 0's is divisible by 5 and no. of 1's is even.
- (iii) The set of all strings of 0's and 1's whose $10^{th}$ symbol from the right end is 1.
- (iv) The set of all strings of 0's and 1's such that every pair of adjacent 0's appears before any pair of adjacent 1's.
Prove that "If $L = L(A)$ for some DFA $A$, then there is a Regular Expression $R$ such that $L = L(R)$."

Define $\varepsilon$-closure. Compute $\varepsilon$-closure of each state and find its equivalent DFA.

| | ε | a | b | c |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| →p | {q} | {p} | φ | φ |
| q | {r} | φ | {q} | φ |
| *r | φ | φ | φ | {r} |
Construct a regular expression corresponding to the state diagram given in the following figure:

figures.alt: Finite automaton with states p (start, accepting, double circle), q and r. p has a self-loop 0 and goes to q on 1. q has a self-loop 1 and goes to r on 0. r goes back to q on 1 and goes to p on 0.

questions.review_note: Photo is ambiguous about the directions of the two edges between q and r and the curved edge at the bottom. Assumed q-0->r, r-1->q and r-0->p so that every state has exactly one 0 and one 1 transition (a DFA).

questions.text: What are the disadvantages of unambiguous parse tree? Give an example.
Design a Context Free Grammar (CFG) for the language $\{A^xB^yC^z \mid x = y \text{ or } y \neq z, \text{ where } x,y,z \ge 0\}$.

What is ambiguous and unambiguous grammar? Consider the following grammar:

$$\begin{aligned}
E &\to aE \mid aEbE \mid \varepsilon
\end{aligned}$$

Is it ambiguous? If yes, give an equivalent unambiguous grammar.
Calculate the left linear and right linear grammar of the regular expression $0(10)^*$.
Define the acceptance of a Push Down Automata (PDA) by empty stack. Is it true that language accepted by a PDA by empty stack or by that of final state are different languages?
Design PDA to accept the language: $L=\{a^mb^m \mid m \ge 0\}$.

Prove the following theorem:

"Let $L$ be $L(P_F)$ for some PDA $P_F = (Q, \Sigma, \Gamma, \delta_F, q_0, z_0, F)$ then there is a PDA $P_N$ such that $L = N(P_N)$."

Use the Context Free Language (CFL) pumping lemma to show each of these languages not to be context free:

- (i) $\{0^i1^j \mid j = i^2\}$,
- (ii) $\{a^nb^nc^n \mid n \ge 1\}$.
Explain how a Turing Machine can be regarded as a computing device to compute integer functions.
Design a Turing Machine to implement "multiplication". Simulate the action for 001000.
What are the differences between single-tape and multi-tape Turing Machine?
Explain the multi tape Turing Machine mode. Is it more powerful that the basic Turing Machine? Justify your answer.

Consider the following grammar

$$\begin{aligned}
S &\to aAa \mid bBb \mid \varepsilon \\
A &\to C \mid a \\
B &\to C \mid b \\
C &\to CDE \mid \varepsilon \\
D &\to A \mid B \mid ab
\end{aligned}$$

- (i) Are there any useless symbols? Eliminate them if so.
- (ii) Eliminate $\varepsilon$-productions.
- (iii) Eliminate unit productions.
- (iv) Put the grammar into Chomosky Normal Form (CNF).
questions.review_note: Printed grammar has no production for E (E appears in C -> CDE); transcribed as printed. This makes C non-generating, which is probably intended.

questions.text: Show that "If a language $L$ and its complement $\overline{L}$ are both recursively enumerable, then both languages are recursive."
Explain the halting problem of Turing Machine.
What is unrestricted grammar? Prove that CFLs are closed under (i) Homonorphism and (ii) Reversal.

State the Pumping lemma for CFL's. Convert the following grammar to a PDA that accepts the same language by empty stack.

$$\begin{aligned}
S &\to aAA \\
A &\to aS \mid bS \mid a
\end{aligned}$$
What is Deterministic PDA (DPDA)? Why does the transition function for DPDA's only work for 1 alphabet symbol and 1 stack symbol?
